name: Elvance
description:
Elvance brings your PreSales workflow into Claude. Find and manage Opportunity Scorecards (always versioned), manage risks and feature gaps, set the Elvance technical stage, log and review activities, and ask analytical questions about your pipeline - all from a conversation.

Everything runs as you, within your existing Salesforce permissions, and is scoped to Elvance only. Never the rest of your Salesforce. Every change follows Elvance's own rules (versioning, required fields, your configured picklists), so your scorecards stay correct.

Key features:
• Opportunities & scorecards - find by name, view, create and update (always as a new version), set the Elvance stage
• Risks & feature gaps - add and update with impact and likelihood, reuse your library, push to Linear/JIRA where configured
• Activities - log and review activities using your org's own types and categories, with time-by-category totals
• Ask Elvance - analytical questions about your own pipeline

Sign-in is per-user Salesforce OAuth. There is no broad Salesforce access. The connector is opt-in and off by default, enabled by your Salesforce admin.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Elvance to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Elvance to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.elvance.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Elvance MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Elvance lists 20 MCP tools, including add_feature_gap, add_risk, create_activity, create_scorecard, find_opportunity, get_activity_options, get_scorecard, list_activities, list_flagged_activities, list_my_opportunities, query_elvance, and resolve_lookup.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Elvance?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Elvance in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Elvance requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Elvance is developed by Elvance. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
